divergence_mpas.accuracy: O(h^2) on a quasi-uniform Voronoi mesh
divergence_mpas.reference: Skamarock et al. (2012), Mon. Wea. Rev. 140:3090-3105, Eq. 24 (MPAS flux-form finite-volume divergence); ESS RFC discretization.md §7.3 worked MPAS-divergence example. Discrete operator: (div F)_i = (1/A_i) * sum_k s_{i,k} * l_{e} * F_{e}, with e = edges_on_cell[i,k] the k-th incident edge of cell i, s_{i,k} = edge_sign_on_cell[i,k] in {+1,-1} the outward-normal orientation (MPAS 'outward_from_first_cell' convention: +1 when cells_on_edge[1,e]==i), l_e = dv_edge[e] the Voronoi edge arc length, A_i = area_cell[i] the cell area, and F_e the edge-normal flux. The coefficient s*l/A is build-time-constant grid geometry (const-folded); only F_e reaches the per-step hot tree.
